svg.title: GitOps flow: from a directory in Git to a running app
svg.desc: The root app from ansible applies the two ApplicationSets in bootstrap/appsets. cluster-apps is a matrix of a list and a git generator: it finds every app.yaml under infrastructure (15) and services (61) and creates 76 Applications. Its templatePatch gives each Application up to four sources: the Helm chart with its value layers, this repository as a values reference, the ingress chart for services with ingress.enabled, and the app's manifests directory when manifests is true. The second ApplicationSet, config-apps, creates base-configs and infra-configs from two fixed paths and keeps autosync. RollingSync then syncs the 76 Applications one wave after another by the deploy-phase label: crds (1: prometheus-operator-crds), foundation (4: cert-manager, metallb, nfs-provisioner, sealed-secrets), controllers (9: traefik, authentik, postgres, redis, pgadmin, crowdsec, proxmox-csi, reloader, intel-device-operator) and services (62: the 61 services plus falco).
svg.text: From a directory in Git to a running app
One Application, up to four sources
built from the fields in its app.yaml

g.text: the Helm chart and its value layers
this repo, so the chart can load its value files
services only: an IngressRoute and an optional Probe
extra objects beside the chart, such as SealedSecrets

svg.text: SECOND APPLICATIONSET · TWO FIXED PATHS, AUTOSYNC ON

g.text: the git generator finds every app.yaml
the label deploy-phase sets the wave

svg.text: RollingSync turns automatic sync and self-heal off for these 76 apps; base-configs and infra-configs keep both.
